precision: Decimal strings for economic values and integer trade counts
revision_policy: Separate manifest versions and quarantine changed slots. No overwrite.
asof_policy: Structural close cutoff applies to final complete archive windows only. Historical decision-time availability is unknown.

live_extension_boundary.L7: Event, receive and durable commit clocks are distinct. Trade/BBO cadence, rolling updates, and final 1m/15m close are separate measurements. Partial bars cannot enter the final-bar consumer.
live_extension_boundary.L8: Quota evidence is a separate per-IP and per-endpoint receipt. Historical ingestion does not infer quota or entitlement.
live_extension_boundary.L9: Transport and quota failures stay in the live package. Shared records retain missingness and finality.
live_extension_boundary.L10: Real-feed measurements remain NOT_RUN until separate rights, authorization and recorded pilot evidence exist.
